extracted.intended_audience: people learning about health evidence and systematic reviews (researchers, clinicians, patients and the public)
extracted.subtask_description: Exploring Cochrane's training and resource materials to learn how to find, interpret, and produce health evidence and systematic reviews (including methods, PICO/scope, risk of bias, patient involvement, and software tools).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sign up for a Cochrane account
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page prompts users to register for a Cochrane account as an initial step to access learning resources and tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence Essentials: free course
rubrics_metrics.description: A beginner's guide to health evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offered as a free course intended for beginners to introduce core concepts of health evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: A beginner's guide to health evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory material for people new to health evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framing material for novices covering foundational topics; presented alongside the Evidence Essentials course.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key steps in a systematic review
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of the principal stages involved in conducting a systematic review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as core procedural guidance for producing systematic reviews (planning, searching, screening, extraction, synthesis, reporting). Specific step details are available via linked resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free, bite-sized videos about systematic reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Short video modules explaining aspects of systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed for concise learning on specific topics; useful for quick introductions or refreshers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Help to shape and share research
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities and resources to contribute to research and disseminate findings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes pathways for involvement and sharing, such as joining networks and engaging with Cochrane activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Join our free Patient and Public Network
rubrics_metrics.description: A network for patients and public contributors to engage with Cochrane work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages involvement of patients and the public in review processes and training; implies standards for patient involvement and contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Courses and resources (methods, review scope/PICO, risk of bias, involving patients, software training and more)
rubrics_metrics.description: A set of learning courses covering review methodology and related topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit topic areas listed: methods; review scope/PICO; risk of bias; involving patients; software training. These topics represent substantive domains one must learn to design, conduct, and appraise reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Webinars
rubrics_metrics.description: Live and recorded webinars on methods, tools, ethics and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Archive of recordings and upcoming webinars used for continued learning. Page reports 214 webinars delivered in the last 9 years and 23,602 attendees over that period—evidence of breadth and experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Events
rubrics_metrics.description: Events, courses and conferences from Cochrane partners globally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calendar/round-up of external and partner events for deeper or in-person training opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handbooks and manuals
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference handbooks and manuals for systematic review methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formal methodological guidance resources that detail standards and procedures for conducting reviews (e.g., step-by-step methods, reporting expectations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Review-writing guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance specifically focused on writing systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers how to structure and write review reports; implies expectations for clarity, completeness, and adherence to methodological reporting standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial policies on Cochrane Library
rubrics_metrics.description: Editorial and policy standards that govern content in the Cochrane Library.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural and policy requirements relevant to producing and publishing reviews in the Cochrane ecosystem (e.g., editorial standards, conflicts of interest, update policies).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cochrane Evidence Synthesis and Methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Cochrane's methodological resources and synthesis expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizational hub for methodological standards, methods research, and best-practice recommendations for evidence synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: The Cochrane journal where systematic reviews are published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary outlet for Cochrane reviews; relevant for understanding publication standards, formatting, and reporting expectations for completed reviews.
